messages.subject_clean: summary with imputations bug ... any workarounds?
messages.body_plain:
The point estimates can be obtained by running Zelig for each imputed 
model and calculating the mean of all five estimates for each parameter. 
Standard errors are a little tricky: see Little and Rubin or Schafer's 
books on multiple imputation for the formulae.  If you know how to do some 
R programming, you can combine all simulation draws from each of the five 
runs.  And then calculate whatever the quantities you like.

Good luck,
Kosuke

uploaded to CRAN today, but it takes several days for CRAN to validate
and push out the old version.  Same thing with Gary's mirror.

survey than the one implemented in Zelig. As long as it still runs,
you can ignore the warning.

in the multiply imputed data frames, ds1-ds5.  You should check to see
what variables are in each of ds1 - ds5 by doing names(ds1) for
example.
